long: Vintage Story is a voxel-based survival and crafting sandbox emphasizing realistic systems like knapping, pottery, and seasonal farming in a procedurally generated world. It features deep progression from stone tools to mechanical contraptions, plus a lore-driven exploration layer. It was developed by Anego Studios and supports multiplayer servers.
name: Vintage Story
short: Vintage Story (native Linux, v1.22.0 with built-in libs)
